case.initial_water_content_rule: common B1.10 constitutive provider evaluated at h0

stage0a_solver_seam.comparison_contract: one identical soil_water_solve_request_t supplied to both concrete soil_water_solver_t implementations

stage0b_transaction_level.reason: F-ROSS12 transaction mode requires a model temporal certificate. RossFast publishes its admitted certificate; the simple Reference E0 composition does not expose the same certificate under the same continuation layout.
stage0b_transaction_level.methodological_rule: Do not compare transaction-level results by silently assigning solver-specific temporal acceptance policies and treating solver identity as the only treatment variable.

identifiability_note: Both E0 boundary fluxes are prescribed. Their equality is experimental-control and conservation evidence, not independent predicted-flux equivalence evidence.
stage1_gate: Predeclare scientific state/storage tolerances from an independent rationale before broad six-material sampling. Observed Stage 0 discrepancies may not be used to fit those tolerances.
later_scientific_requirement: Predicted-flux admissibility requires a later independently qualified envelope in which at least one scientifically relevant boundary flux is a model outcome rather than fully prescribed input.
